name: Expandable Action Menu
description: An expanding tab bar with a rotating FAB and cascading menu items
longDescription: A fluid tab bar that expands vertically when the center FAB is pressed. It features a sliding pill indicator for active tabs, a smoothly rotating floating action button, and a frosted-glass-like action menu with cascading entry animations.
features: Liquid sliding pill indicator for active tab
Perfectly centered FAB that spins into an 'X'
Cascading staggered menu item entrance animations
Fully powered by react-native-reanimated spring physics

usage.title: Basic Usage
usage.description: Render the expandable action menu at the bottom of your screen.

steps: Copy ExpandableActionMenu.tsx to your components folder
Import and use in your layout
